thesis: The precise claim is conditional: over an independently justified comparison domain, P(e1)=P(e2) implies R(e1)=R(e2), so unequal recollective outputs entail unequal original phenomenal types. This condition permits extensive transformation and information loss. Matching outputs require an additional condition, globally injectivity or locally a singleton preimage. Phenomenal holism alone does not exclude this structure. The manuscript expressly does not establish that human memory satisfies the condition, that a detected difference concerns the investigated feature, or that the result directly covers perception–recollection comparisons.
claimed_contribution: A targeted countermodel to the necessity of full phenomenal reconstruction, using whole phenomenal types without subtracting an invariant component. The proposed contribution combines this application with distinctions between manufactured and erased differences, global and observation-specific conditions, and formal entailment and independently warranted evidence. The author explicitly disclaims mathematical novelty and acknowledges the relevant-similarity response already discussed by Nourbakhshi.

findings.manuscript_location: “Why holism does not close this route”: “structural preservation and preservation of parts”; “Three objections to the limited result”: “Treating recollections as evidence, rather than as reenactments”; Bibliography.
findings.claim: The literature positioning omits a directly relevant structural account of episodic representation.
findings.analysis: Andonovski 2022 is a useful uncited comparator: it connects simplified episodic models with inference about represented events. Its explicit separation of model content from memory-experience content also helps explain the difference from W01. See the comparison under closest_predecessors and [Andonovski’s primary text](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/psychology/articles/10.3389/fpsyg.2022.899371/full). The omission is demonstrable; it does not establish duplication of W01’s countermodel.
findings.effect_on_conclusion: No stated conditional conclusion fails. The contribution should remain positioned as a particular argument about phenomenal comparison, rather than a general discovery that imperfect episodic representations can support inference.
findings.repair_conditions: Acknowledge this comparator and explain the difference between structural models of events and the proposed mapping between whole phenomenal types.

surviving_contribution: The defensible remainder is the specific application of a familiar mathematical distinction to the full-reflection requirement: a nonidentity, noninjective mapping can exclude manufactured differences without preserving an independently inspectable phenomenal component. The manuscript also makes explicit why an actual-pair conditional supplies no independent warrant, why equality requires additional information, and why noise prevents straightforward deterministic contraposition. The opened literature establishes relevant antecedents and adjacent arguments, but did not establish a prior presentation of this complete combination. That is a limited search result, not proof of originality.
remaining_questions: In “What a comparison must preserve,” the requirement is “independent grounds concerning a domain delimited before drawing the inference.” What available evidence could justify such a domain for whole phenomenal types? This remains an acknowledged application question, not a contradiction in the consistency result.

In “Three objections to the limited result,” the author says the weaker objection can accept “everything argued here.” How much argumentative disagreement remains once the target is restricted to the strong necessity claim? The source supports that restriction, but the result should not be presented as defeating the surviving evidential objection.

In “Why holism does not close this route,” the claim concerns “structural preservation.” Does Swoyer’s detailed treatment of structural representation contain a closer formal antecedent than the accessible sources establish? His full argument was unavailable, so this comparison remains unresolved.
limitations: This was a finite public-web audit, principally of English-language philosophical literature. It cannot establish exhaustive originality or exclude relevant material in inaccessible books, unindexed publications, or other languages.

The supplied manuscript, including its complete bibliography, was read. No other project manuscripts, author-identification material, previous reviews, private records, or global memory were sought. No agents, shell/file/MCP tools, manuscript modifications, submissions, or publication actions were used.

Several publisher and repository routes failed. Relevant passages in all three cited works were ultimately checked through accessible primary texts, with bibliographic identity checked separately. Author manuscripts were not collated word for word against every final published version.
Swoyer 1991 was accessible only as publisher metadata, abstract, and references. Its detailed definitions and proofs were not read and are not treated as established overlap.

The empirical check was limited. It did not establish the manuscript’s extensional condition for any real memory procedure, nor independently test every listed influence on recollection. The pain, sunset, and tree cases remain illustrations rather than verified experimental results.

citation_audit.manuscript_location: “What a comparison must preserve”: P(e1)=P(e2) implies R(e1)=R(e2); “Two directions of error”: “Only the observed output needs a single possible input type”; “The assumption real memories must earn”: “Two draws from one distribution can differ.”
citation_audit.evidence: These claims follow from the stated definitions and examples; no external theorem is attributed. The four-to-two table verifies information loss without manufactured differences. The singleton-preimage qualification correctly limits what a particular match establishes. Equal output distributions do not force equal individual draws. The explicit disclaimer of mathematical novelty is appropriate.

citation_audit.manuscript_reference: Uncited empirical background and illustrative memory cases.
citation_audit.manuscript_location: Opening: “Remembering a painful afternoon need not hurt”; “What a comparison must preserve”: “retrieved under a leading cue”; “Two directions of error”: “A vivid reconstruction could incorporate information acquired later”; “The assumption real memories must earn”: R(e)=G(P(e),z(e)).
citation_audit.evidence: [Loftus and Palmer](https://gwern.net/doc/psychology/cognitive-bias/1974-loftus.pdf), Experiments I–II and Discussion, support the limited claim that later wording can affect reports. They distinguish response bias from memory alteration and do not establish phenomenal-type equality or vividness effects. No opened experiment directly checked the pain, sunset, tree, or complete z-factor examples. These are presented principally as possibilities, so the incomplete empirical check establishes no false claim.
